== Description ==
This entity is the entity that appeared in Teaser 3 for the [[Unnamed Sector]].

== Behavior ==
Once a door is opened, It will place itself inside one of the Monitors in the room and play a distorted version of bass.wav, moments later breaking out and checking every gray locker in the main room, after it is done checking it will go back into the monitor and despawn.
